d:
Welcome to my craziest travel adventure yet! In this fast-paced vlog, we are diving headfirst into La Paz, Bolivia—a city that literally sits in the clouds. From bizarre encounters at the Witches' Market to sweeping across the skyline in the Mi Teleférico cable cars, this is a first impression you won't want to miss.
Surviving the Extreme Altitude
The moment you step off the plane in La Paz, your body immediately feels the extreme environment.
